source.title: New named original ore/herb cast-log search and deduplication

notes: This run prioritized T0020/T0046/T0041/T0019 prospecting (Draconium, Serevite, Khaz'gorite, Prismatic) and T0018/T0015 milling (Bubble Poppy, Saxifrage) before disenchanting fallback. Searches yielded no newly independent source-original material-per-completed-cast histogram; known Reddit cohorts and guide tables are already indexed or reference-only, not reentered. New Wowhead Looter gear cohorts recorded separately in this file. Resourcefulness actual completed casts and rank-specific output denominators remain unknown. Live page HTML for most candidates suppressed JS tables; indexed Wowhead source excerpts report the numbers preserved above. A secondary scrape service had insufficient credits and provided no numerical evidence.
lookingFor: Nonduplicated original 0-N per-material results of completed Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic Ore prospects or Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage mills with ranks, skill, specialization and Resourcefulness input refunds
whereLooked: reddit.com/r/woweconomy: name-first Draconium Ore and Serevite Ore original prospecting spreadsheets/result tables and per-cast logs; already represented 2022–23 first-person cohorts only
reddit.com/r/woweconomy: name-first Khaz'gorite Ore and Prismatic Ore ranked original prospects, zero/hit/2+ materials and refund events; prior originals already indexed

wowhead.com: named Dragon Isles Prospecting/Prismatic Ore original comments and ranked ore pages; previously indexed historical observations; new original gear Looter source tables for 194401, 194406, 202463 separately recorded
wow-professions.com: Dragon Isles herb milling batch and output reference guides, not sampled per-completed-cast pigment histograms
us.forums.blizzard.com: named Bubble Poppy milling measured outcomes and per-operation data; no novel raw pigment result ledger
warcraft.wiki.gg: named Saxifrage and Bubble Poppy mill output mappings; reference facts only, not source-original cast samples
github.com: named Draconium Ore prospecting result CSV/export, Serevite Ore rank-specific logs; no new public original player event data

wowhead.com: independent unused item name and ID candidates Field Scout's Boots (194383), Expedition Guard's Helm (194380), Nokhud Reaver Chestplate (197639), Doomsayer's Greatsword (194395), Lurking Specter's Edgeband (202494), Underlight Conjurer's Treads (202553) were excluded as existing evidence cohorts
